newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria 1997 inflation seen at 566 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria 1997 inflation seen at 566 pct.

text.p: Bulgaria's consumer price inflation for 1997 is expected to be 566 percent, Finance Minister Muravei Radev said on Tuesday.
"Annual inflation is projected at 566 percent in this year's draft budget," Radev told a news conference.
Monthly inflation for May was seen at 3.5 percent after -0.7 in April and cumulative inflation for the first five months was estimated at 467.6 percent, preliminary Finance Ministry figures showed.
Inflation projections were calculated under an exchange rate of 1,000 levs per mark or 1,700 levs per dollar.

Inflation was expected to slow under the currency board system as central bank lending to the government and commercial banks would be banned to prevent the printing of money and stabilise the economy. -- Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 911 88
